name: Crypto.com Card
summary: Popular crypto card with tiered rewards based on CRO staking. Offers cashback up to 8% with higher tiers.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the Crypto.com Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$50.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Crypto.com Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Crypto.com Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
